current_authority_observed.note: Research-only mapping. No provider execution, VPS testing, effect dispatch, or runtime promotion was performed.

donor_facts: The repository is primarily a Claude Code skill/reference corpus, not a reusable runtime SDK.
It uses selective/progressive skill loading rather than loading the full corpus into every task.
Its performance-testing method is an ordered workflow with prerequisites, discovery, execution, monitoring, analysis and report artifacts.
Its evaluation work includes with-method/without-method paired comparisons and quality/cost measurements.
Its own benchmark reports quality gains correlated with actual method invocation, but that is upstream self-evidence and not Frankenstein-2.0 causal evidence.

F2-WP-304.name: memory distillation
F2-WP-304.mechanism: Progressive disclosure and selective method loading become a distillation rule: retain exact provenance/source digest plus a compact routing descriptor, and materialize detailed method content only after relevance/policy selection.
F2-WP-304.native_form: Distilled method descriptor plus immutable provenance reference; no plugin loader and no executable authority.
F2-WP-304.expected_resource_effect: Lower default context load while preserving access to full method evidence when selected.

F2-WP-305.name: method memory
F2-WP-305.mechanism: Translate donor skill/reference modules into typed F2-native MethodMemory records.
F2-WP-305.native_form: method_id, version/source digest, applicability/prerequisites, ordered steps, expected evidence/artifacts, cost hints, failure modes, provenance and status. MethodMemory is advisory/retrieval state only and cannot become scheduler, truth or effect authority.
F2-WP-305.expected_resource_effect: Reuse mature procedures without importing a second runtime or repeatedly regenerating long procedural prompts.

F2-WP-306.name: transfer validator
F2-WP-306.mechanism: Use controlled paired evaluation inspired by upstream with-method/without-method evals as the admission gate for transferring a method into a target task family.
F2-WP-306.native_form: Same fixture family and grading contract across baseline and selected-method conditions, plus a deliberately mismatched-method negative control. Measure valid completion, domain rubric quality, fail-closed violations, latency, context/token cost, route precision and abstention accuracy.
F2-WP-306.promotion_rule: A method is not admitted merely because it exists, is cited, or improves prose quality. It must show task-family benefit over baseline, survive the mismatched-method control, and stay within declared cost/safety bounds.

F2-WP-902.name: bounded evolutionary optimization
F2-WP-902.mechanism: Paired evaluation can later provide an offline bounded fitness signal for method selection/routing policy variants.
F2-WP-902.native_form: Shadow/offline policy tuning only, gated by rollback/control work such as WP903 and never allowed to self-modify canonical state, effects or completion authority.
F2-WP-902.promotion_rule: Do not promote to automatic evolutionary optimization until a bounded WP305/WP306 slice has reproducible F2-native evaluation evidence.

adjacent_interfaces_not_claimed.F2-WP-301: rank candidate methods by task/state relevance
adjacent_interfaces_not_claimed.F2-WP-302: filter by provenance, generation and causal/evidence constraints

explicit_rejections: REJECT importing the Claude-specific plugin/skill runtime as an F2 control plane.
REJECT making a skill/method file a scheduler, canonical truth source, state authority, completion authority or effect authority.
REJECT executing donor test/auto-tuning workflows as real effects without the existing canonical authorization/effect path.
REJECT treating method citation or invocation frequency as causal proof of quality.
REJECT loading the entire donor corpus by default; this defeats the resource-efficiency objective and increases context contamination risk.
hypothesis: A compact F2-native method router plus typed MethodMemory can raise task-family answer/action quality at lower average context cost than always-on procedural prompting, while preserving one deterministic authority substrate.
counterhypotheses: Observed donor gains may come mainly from adding more task-specific instructions rather than from intelligent routing.
Wrong-route risk and routing overhead may erase quality gains on small or already-well-specified tasks.
Benchmark gains reported by the donor may not transfer to F2 task families or models.

design: Freeze a small family-disjoint task fixture set with deterministic scoring where possible.
Run BASELINE_NO_METHOD and SELECTED_METHOD under the same task and grading contract.
Add MISMATCHED_METHOD as a hard negative to separate useful method selection from generic extra-context effects.
Where feasible, cap or normalize context budget so extra tokens alone cannot explain the result.
Record route decision, method identity/digest, evidence outputs, score, failure class, latency and context cost.
Perform no real-world effects; the first discriminator is read-only/evaluation-only.
falsifiers: MISMATCHED_METHOD performs similarly to SELECTED_METHOD across task families.
SELECTED_METHOD does not improve valid completion or domain quality over BASELINE_NO_METHOD.
Quality improvement exists but latency/context cost or fail-closed regressions exceed the bounded acceptance threshold.

handoff.next_bounded_delta: Implement the smallest F2-native WP305 MethodMemory record/schema plus WP306 paired-eval contract/scaffold and a mismatched-method negative control; keep it read-only and persistence/effect-authority neutral.
handoff.do_not_duplicate: Current WP507/GWT instrumentation lanes or unrelated active workpackages.
